items.title: Science Corporation implants its vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient
items.summary: Max Hodak, the former president and co-founder of Neuralink, detailed on stage at TechCrunch Disrupt how his company's work with PRIMA is part of its path toward a novel brain-computer interface (BCI).
items.author: Aisha Malik

items.title: Cerebras CEO says we’re nearing a future where everyone has a personal AI assistant at home
items.summary: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman predicts a future where personal AI assistants become as commonplace as household appliances, running partly on local devices and partly in the cloud.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: Industrial Next wants factory robots to switch tasks in minutes, not weeks
items.summary: Industrial Next helps manufacturers automate complex, delicate tasks that have traditionally required human labor.
items.author: Aisha Malik

items.title: Cerebras CEO pushes back on AI doomsday warnings
items.summary: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman has a message for AI leaders spreading doomsday warnings: Maybe stop talking? At TechCrunch Disrupt, he argued that the industry's focus on AI's risks is drowning out its potential benefits.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
items.summary: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees, as well as private messages and testimony from key figures in the case.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: Flox Intelligence is building AI to keep wildlife away from trains, airports, and roads
items.summary: Flox's edge devices can identify animals and use species-specific sounds to drive them away from critical infrastructure.
items.author: Ram Iyer

items.title: Facebook is giving users more control over their algorithm
items.summary: Meta announced the launch of its new AI-powered feature, “Your Algorithm,” a feature it first launched on Instagram.
items.author: Lauren Forristal

items.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
items.summary: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: Pluto Security raises $42M as AI gives enterprise security teams a new headache
items.summary: The problem with giving everyone in a company access to AI tools is that people will use them in unexpected ways. And that fact is steadily seeding fears that companies now have new, gaping security holes in their systems or, at least, will soon.
items.author: Ram Iyer

items.title: Google Play now lets anyone build private, vibe-coded apps that run on Android
items.summary: Google is making it easier to build and use personal Android apps created with AI, without having to make them available to everyone on the Play Store.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: SpaceX and Google both said no. Now his software is riding a SpaceX rocket next to Google’s
items.summary: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.
items.author: Tim Fernholz

items.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Day 1
items.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 officially kicks off today. See what's in store for Day 1 (Oct. 13) at San Francisco's Moscone West. Don't miss it. Register for your pass now and meet 10,000+ tech leaders at the startup epicenter of the year.
items.author: TechCrunch Events

items.title: SpaceXSI bundles X Premium, Grok, and Cursor into one subscription
items.summary: The new X Subscription combines X's paid features with AI tools like Grok and Cursor, offering plans ranging from $8 to $200 per month.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: The final Disrupt Stage lineup: Three days of conversations you won’t hear anywhere outside of TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: The full TechCrunch Disrupt Stage lineup revealed, featuring Max Hodak, Mark Wahlberg, Benchmark partners, and more. Register now to save up to $100 on your pass and get a second at 50% off.
items.author: TechCrunch Events

items.title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
items.summary: American Express is introducing a new framework designed to ensure AI agents only make purchases their users have authorized, potentially preventing costly mistakes and disputes as AI-powered shopping grows.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
items.summary: The startup will sell some of its assets to Disney for $20 million.
items.author: Ivan Mehta
